resources.string: Sends your steps, calories and floors from Google Health to the DataDial watch face, so the watch shows the same numbers as the Google Health app. It reads them from Health Connect every 15 minutes and when the watch asks. The data goes only to your watch.
Health Connect isn\'t available on this phone.
Tap Allow access and allow all: steps, total calories burned, floors climbed, and access in the background.

Last sent to the watch at %1$s:
%2$d steps
%3$d calories
%4$d floors
(Google Health data up to %5$s)
